main_result.description: The modeled router calculates module capacities, distributes the requested deposits using the proportional allocation algorithm and converts the resulting allocations to wei. Under the stated conditions, the complete modeled calculation matches the independent mathematical specification.
main_result.model: Source execution model with a Verity module-call interpretation; the linked library call is recorded, not executed in the VM

theorems.name: LidoSRv3.Audit.Source.TrioComposition.FinalMemoryStoredParent.public_iff
theorems.statement:
theorem public_iff (target : Address) (memory : MemoryWords) (pointer : Word)
    (layout : Layout) (storage : Storage) (oracle : StaticOracle) (config : Config)
    (amount : Word) (isTopUp : Bool) (before after : Transcript) (trace : MemoryTransportCall.Trace)
    (result : Except Failure ParentOutput) (hc : (storage (countSlot layout)).val ≤ 32)
    (space : pointer.val+1184*(storage (countSlot layout)).val+704 ≤ 2^32) :
    ParentSpec.Public layout storage oracle config amount isTopUp before result after ↔
      project (program target memory pointer layout storage oracle config amount isTopUp before trace) = (result,after)

theorems.name: LidoSRv3.Audit.Source.TrioComposition.FinalMemoryStoredParent.success
theorems.doc:
/-- Successful output is read from the actual resulting memory. Its public
specification and both array relations follow; no expected output is supplied. -/
theorems.statement:
theorem success (target : Address) (memory : MemoryWords) (pointer : Word)
    (layout : Layout) (storage : Storage) (oracle : StaticOracle) (config : Config)
    (amount : Word) (isTopUp : Bool) (before : Transcript) (trace : MemoryTransportCall.Trace)
    (out : Output) (hc : (storage (countSlot layout)).val ≤ 32)
    (space : pointer.val+1184*(storage (countSlot layout)).val+704 ≤ 2^32)
    (executed : (program target memory pointer layout storage oracle config amount isTopUp before trace).result = .ok out) :
    ParentSpec.Public layout storage oracle config amount isTopUp before (.ok (observe out))
      (program target memory pointer layout storage oracle config amount isTopUp before trace).modules ∧
    ArrayAt out.memory out.ap.val (observe out).allocated ∧
    ArrayAt out.memory out.rp.val (observe out).newAllocations

theorems.name: LidoSRv3.Audit.Source.TrioComposition.VerityParent.stored_correspondence
theorems.doc:
/-- The module-call VM and the complete stored source parent have identical
returns/reverts and module transcripts. The separately recorded closed-library
event is a source observable; this theorem does not execute a linked delegatecall
in the VM. The VM external world remains unchanged on every result. -/
theorems.statement:
theorem stored_correspondence (target : Address) (memory : MemoryWords) (pointer : Word)
    (layout : Layout) (config : Config) (amount : Word) (isTopUp : Bool)
    (adversary : DenoteExternalCalls.AdversaryModel) (state : DenoteExternalCalls.CallState)
    (before : Transcript) (trace : MemoryTransportCall.Trace)
    (countBound : (VerityProducer.worldStorage state.world (countSlot layout)).val ≤ 32)
    (space : pointer.val+1184*(VerityProducer.worldStorage state.world (countSlot layout)).val+704 ≤ 2^32) :
    (executeWithMemory pointer layout config amount isTopUp adversary state before).1 =
      FinalMemoryStoredParent.project (FinalMemoryStoredParent.program target memory pointer layout
        (VerityProducer.worldStorage state.world) (VerityProducer.sourceOracle adversary state.world)
        config amount isTopUp before trace) ∧
    (executeWithMemory pointer layout config amount isTopUp adversary state before).2.world = state.world

summary: step_correspondence_and_full_loop_conservation is the registered parent. Its first conjunct retains the explicit-∀ independent Model/Source candidate correspondence, Model.amount equality, positivity, demand bound, and capacity bound. Its second conjunct proves exact request conservation for every successful fuel-bounded sourceAllocateLoop run. Its third conjunct proves that the independently defined proportional Nat modelAllocateLoop has a matching successful run with equal mathematical totals and RowsCorrespond final rows; the proof lifts the relation across every successful mutation. The sourceAllocateLoop_eq_allocateLoop bridge still connects conservation to the Verity executor. The distinct +1 Nat model remains a separate child, and no Solidity equivalence is claimed. The registered abstract parent also consumes the unbounded decoded-array proportional executor: array extents derive success, independent distribution, bucket-total conservation and demand bounds without supplied fuel or a successful-run premise. Physical ABI/memory and deployment correspondence remain open. The fifth conjunct consumes actual source producer memory stores, canonical ABI execution and ordered call/return observations, deriving independent distribution and result length under explicit separation, extent and producer-success premises. This is source-memory correspondence, not compiled or deployed frame refinement.

classification.work: Keep the checked proportional model/source multi-step correspondence and conservation in the parent, with the +1 model as a separate child. theorems.name: LidoSRv3.Audit.Guarantees.PAlloc2.step_correspondence_and_full_loop_conservation
theorems.doc:
/-- **Registered P-ALLOC-2 parent.**  This keeps the independent model/source
candidate and proportional-amount equality from the step theorem load-bearing,
and adds fuel-bounded conservation for every successful run of the full
independently stated source allocation loop, plus multi-step row correspondence
with an independently stated proportional model loop.  It does not identify
that proportional loop with the separate +1 `MinFirst` child model. It also
consumes the unbounded checked source loop, deriving its success and independent
proportional distribution/conservation from array extents alone. -/
theorems.statement:
theorem step_correspondence_and_full_loop_conservation :
    StepMatchesModel ∧ FullLoopConserves ∧ LoopStaysInCorrespondence ∧
      UnboundedProportionalLoop ∧ SourceMemoryCallCorrespondence

theorems.role: registered Verity Executable Contract parent (audit/guarantees.yaml verity.theorem)
theorems.name: LidoSRv3.Audit.Guarantees.PAlloc2.verity_tx_simulates_min_first_distribution
theorems.doc:
/-- If the two memory arrays decode to `buckets`/`capacities`, then
`observe` of `allocate` (persisted bucket array plus totals) equals
`sourceView` of the separately defined `sourceAllocateLoop`; the copied loop
equations are connected to the executor by a proved equality theorem.
Not the +1 `selects_least_open_bucket` model. -/
theorems.statement:
theorem verity_tx_simulates_min_first_distribution
    (buckets capacities : List MinFirstAllocation.Source.Word)
    (allocationSize : MinFirstAllocation.Source.Word) (state : Verity.ContractState)
    (hBuckets : Verity.MinFirstDistributionTx.readArray state "buckets"
      Verity.MinFirstDistributionTx.bucketsBase buckets.length = some buckets)
    (hCapacities : Verity.MinFirstDistributionTx.readArray state "capacities"
      Verity.MinFirstDistributionTx.capacitiesBase capacities.length = some capacities) :
    Verity.MinFirstDistributionTx.observe buckets
        ((Verity.MinFirstDistributionTx.allocate buckets.length capacities.length
          allocationSize).run
        state) =
      Verity.MinFirstDistributionTx.sourceView buckets capacities allocationSize

assumptions.risk: Canonical runtime, codehash, fork configuration, and address provenance are unavailable in general; Mock-derived evidence is non-production evidence. Chantier 4 (Thomas 2026-09-13) narrows this for two deployed-runtime fixtures under `fixtures/deployed/` to exact identifiers: `WithdrawalVault_implementation` at `0xfB4521BD151BFB45DB6045D2d07e58e0f597e340` with EIP-1052 codehash `0xd1e0d1b48e4f5abd04bdfd14805366f0cf7946b7bb41b7a5ad8652361f3e3d36` (mainnet, block-independent at any block where the immutable code has not been upgraded — the implementation slot on the WithdrawalVault_proxy `0xB9D7934878B5FB9610B3fE8A5e441e8fad7E293f` points at this deployed runtime, and the runtime is not upgradeable); `StakingRouter_implementation` at `0xDD76927045435C7605cf6f5F978cfb8CABDb5F80` with codehash `0x9cd5d45ddde5f74d3867aa22c98fd79a85df89d202145bc588173d92e00600ec` (same block-independence rationale). Under `ETH_RPC_URL`, the `verify_*_immutable.py` scripts re-fetch and re-verify against the live chain, so a mismatch fails the build; without `ETH_RPC_URL`, they enforce the pinned codehash. For every other contract or configuration under this assumption, the generic reduction stands.
assumptions.justification: This premise isolates an unproved environment or representation fact instead of hiding it in the theorem. Chantier 4 (Thomas 2026-09-13) narrows this for the two deployed-runtime fixtures under `fixtures/deployed/` by recording their exact EIP-1052 EXTCODEHASH (keccak256 of the runtime bytecode) in `audit/artifacts.lock.json`: `WithdrawalVault_implementation` (0xfB4521BD151BFB45DB6045D2d07e58e0f597e340) codehash = 0xd1e0d1b48e4f5abd04bdfd14805366f0cf7946b7bb41b7a5ad8652361f3e3d36, `StakingRouter_implementation` (0xDD76927045435C7605cf6f5F978cfb8CABDb5F80) codehash = 0x9cd5d45ddde5f74d3867aa22c98fd79a85df89d202145bc588173d92e00600ec. That is the exact identifier `EXTCODEHASH <implementation>` on any Ethereum node returns for either implementation at any block where the code has not been upgraded. The `verify_*_immutable.py` scripts (invoked from `make test`) recompute keccak256 of the fixture and reject any mismatch; under `ETH_RPC_URL` they also refetch and re-verify against the live chain.
assumptions.violation_impact: Any guarantee linked to this premise must be re-evaluated if the premise is false.
assumptions.validation: Applies to every guarantee. scripts/check_deployed_code.py reads each proxy implementation slot, hashes the on-chain bytecode and compares the verified source with the pinned lido-core checkout; PROVENANCE.md explains the procedure. Chantier 4 additions: for the two deployed-runtime fixtures the exact EIP-1052 codehash is recorded (see `justification`) and enforced by `scripts/verify_beacon_deposit_immutable.py`, `scripts/verify_consolidation_request_immutable.py`, and `scripts/verify_deposit_thirty_two_ether.py` (all three are `make test` targets). A mismatch between the recomputed keccak256 and the recorded codehash fails the build; `ETH_RPC_URL` enables live re-verification against the current chain state.
assumptions.removal_path: Replace the premise with a machine-checked correspondence theorem or a narrower proved interface.
